qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Physiotherapy (BPT), MBBS with Post Graduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in Radiology
qualification.details: Physiotherapist: Bachelor's Degree in Physiotherapy (BPT) from a recognized university or institution, Registration with the respective State Physiotherapy Council or recognized statutory body, Minimum one year of post-qualification clinical experience. Radiologist: MBBS Degree from a recognised University/Institution, Post Graduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in Radiology from an MCI-recognised Institution, Completion of the compulsory one-year rotating internship, Valid registration with the West Bengal Medical Council or National Medical Council.

salary_details.details: Physiotherapist: ₹30,000/- per month Radiologist: ₹3,000/- per day for attending twice a week from 10:00 am to 02:00 pm

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Cantonment Board Barrackpore Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: http://barrackpore.cantt.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Cantonment Board Barrackpore Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://barrackpore.cantt.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Cantonment Board Barrackpore recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Cantonment Board Barrackpore recruitment is 12 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment offers vacancies for the posts of Physiotherapist and Radiologist. There is one vacancy for each post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: For the Physiotherapist post, candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Physiotherapy (BPT) from a recognized university and have at least one year of post-qualification clinical experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification needed for the Radiologist position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Radiologist post, candidates need an MBBS Degree along with a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in Radiology from an MCI-recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by Cantonment Board Barrackpore.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The application mode for these vacancies is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Physiotherapist post will receive a salary of ₹30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. How is the salary structured for the Radiologist post?
faq.answer: The Radiologist will be compensated at a rate of ₹3,000/- per day for attending twice a week, with working hours from 10:00 am to 02:00 pm.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will involve an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Cantonment Board Barrackpore, the link for which is provided in the Important Links section.
